basic_info.description: Incredible Value at Blu! Experience the ultimate in luxury living with this meticulously renovated 2Br/2Ba residence in the heart of South Beach. Boasting an open floor plan and premium-grade finishes, this home features floor-to-ceiling wrap-around windows that bathe the space in natural light and offer stunning city views. The chef-inspired kitchen is a standout, complete with a grand island for seating, custom cabinetry, and top-of-the-line GE appliances. The master suite, featuring a giant walk-in closet, serves as a private retreat with a spa-like en-suite bath, marble floors, designer sinks, and a frameless glass shower. Designed for both comfort and style, this unit includes A/C, 1 deeded parking space, and access to 24/7 concierge service in a boutique building. BLU provides an intimate community experience with a lush shared garden, BBQ, and picnic area, ensuring privacy and convenience. Ideally located near downtown, FiDi, world-class dining & nightlife, waterfront attractions, tech hubs, BART, Caltrain, MOMA, Ballpark, and Salesforce Park, this property offers a rare opportunity for both luxury living and high rental potential.
